evidence.title: Is Next-Chunk Reasoning RL Really Better than SFT? Revisiting Training Strategies under no-CoT Data

summary: Researchers compared a next‑chunk reasoning reinforcement‑learning approach to standard supervised fine‑tuning on datasets lacking chain‑of‑thought annotations. The analysis shows that while RL offers modest gains on certain benchmarks, it does not consistently outperform SFT across the board, prompting calls for more nuanced training strategies.
title: Study Reexamines Next-Chunk Reasoning Reinforcement Learning Versus Supervised Fine‑Tuning Without Chain‑of‑Thought Data
